findings.title: Team admin/owner check requires both instead of either
findings.body: isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed as `await isTeamAdmin(...) && await isTeamOwner(...)`. A team admin who is not also an owner (the normal case) will fail this check and be denied, while the intent is admin OR owner. The consequence is legitimate team admins cannot add guests; only owners who are also admins (or organizers/attendees via the other clauses) pass. Change && to ||.

findings.title: Guest dedup and blacklist bypass via case/whitespace
findings.body: uniqueGuests filters with `guest === attendee.email` and `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` but only the blacklist list is lowercased — the incoming guest is not normalized (no trim/toLowerCase). An existing attendee `Foo@x.com` can be re-added as `foo@x.com`, and a blacklisted `spam@x.com` can be bypassed as `Spam@X.com` or with whitespace. This creates duplicate Attendee rows differing only by case and defeats BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.

findings.title: Email routing uses unfiltered guest list
findings.body: Attendees are created from `uniqueGuests` (duplicates/existing/blacklisted filtered out) but `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` is called with the original `guests` input. In packages/emails/email-manager.ts new vs existing is decided by `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)`, so a pre-existing attendee re-submitted in the request will be misclassified as new and receive AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of AttendeeAddGuestsEmail, and case differences break the match. Pass `uniqueGuests`.

findings.title: Unbounded guests array with no dedup limit
findings.body: Schema is `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no min/max length, no uniqueness refinement, and no trimming/normalization. A caller can submit hundreds/thousands of emails in one request, creating that many Attendee rows, calendar updates, and outbound emails. The duplicate-within-request case is also not rejected server-side, risking unique-constraint errors or duplicate attendees. Add max length, nonempty, uniqueness and normalization.

findings.title: No booking status/time guard before adding guests
findings.body: Handler only checks NOT_FOUND then permission, never checks booking.status or startTime/endTime. Guests can therefore be added to CANCELLED/REJECTED or already-ended bookings, which then triggers calendar updates and confirmation ICS emails for a dead event. The UI also exposes Edit > Additional guests for past confirmed bookings. Reject non-ACCEPTED/past bookings server-side and hide the action in BookingListItem.
